answer: Because the pulse reference is updated at each tundra checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the horizon audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism hence earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 128 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 3 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
